dimensions.description: Alignment between the scope, seniority, and ownership level demonstrated in the baseline and what the role requires.

strong_match.criteria: Baseline clearly shows ownership of a multi-level support organization with leadership scope equal to or exceeding the role.

moderate_match.criteria: Baseline shows senior leadership but with slightly narrower scope or fewer teams than role requires.

partial_match.criteria: Baseline shows some leadership but mostly IC or team-lead level.

weak_match.criteria: Baseline leadership experience is materially below role scope.

no_match.criteria: Baseline does not demonstrate leadership or ownership at the required level.

dimensions.description: Depth of experience building, operating, and optimizing support processes and operating rhythms.

strong_match.criteria: Baseline shows end-to-end ownership of KPIs, SLAs, QA, and operational reporting.

moderate_match.criteria: Baseline shows strong ops experience but missing one or two core areas.

partial_match.criteria: Baseline shows exposure but not ownership of ops rigor.

weak_match.criteria: Baseline mentions ops concepts without clear implementation responsibility.

no_match.criteria: No evidence of structured support operations experience.

dimensions.description: Hands-on experience selecting, implementing, and operating modern support tooling.

strong_match.criteria: Baseline shows direct ownership of ticketing platform selection, migration, and optimization.

moderate_match.criteria: Baseline shows deep usage and admin experience but not full ownership of migration.

partial_match.criteria: Baseline shows user-level or limited admin experience.

weak_match.criteria: Baseline references tools without demonstrating depth.

dimensions.description: Alignment with the business domain and customer complexity of the role.

strong_match.criteria: Baseline shows direct experience supporting accounting, billing, or compliance-heavy workflows.

moderate_match.criteria: Baseline shows adjacent B2B SaaS experience with some financial exposure.

partial_match.criteria: Baseline shows general SaaS support with no domain depth.

weak_match.criteria: Baseline experience is mostly unrelated to the domain.

dimensions.description: Ability to lead change, influence cross-functionally, and advocate for customers.

strong_match.criteria: Baseline clearly demonstrates leading change and influencing across Product, Engineering, and Exec teams.

moderate_match.criteria: Baseline shows collaboration but limited ownership of change initiatives.

partial_match.criteria: Baseline shows participation but not leadership in change efforts.

weak_match.criteria: Baseline mentions collaboration without concrete examples.

no_match.criteria: No evidence of change leadership or advocacy.

penalties.description: Baseline seniority is materially below the role level.
penalties.trigger: Baseline shows only IC or team-lead scope while role requires head or director level ownership.

penalties.description: Role requires regulated or accounting-heavy domain with no adjacent baseline experience.
penalties.trigger: Job domain includes accounting or compliance and baseline shows none.
